whoWeAre.title: Who we are
desc: We bring over 15 years of international experience (United Kingdom) in smart home systems, high-end AV installations, and advanced building automation.

We design and deliver exclusive solutions that seamlessly integrate technology into a perfectly unified system—with a focus on comfort, design, and absolute reliability. We work with premium platforms such as Crestron, Crestron Home, Loxone, and Lutron, enabling intuitive control of lighting, audio, video, shading, and the entire property environment.

We integrate all technologies—from multimedia and lighting to energy management—into a single elegant and easy-to-use platform. The result is a space that responds to user needs and delivers a truly exceptional experience.

Our projects also include advanced property security solutions. We implement professional systems from brands such as Jablotron, Paradox, and Risco, access control solutions like Salto, and modern surveillance and networking technologies from Ubiquiti.
Every project is unique to us—we create tailored solutions that meet the highest standards of security, aesthetics, and technological excellence.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.subtitle: Your home is your sanctuary
description: P&A Vision transforms your house into an oasis of comfort. We merge Crestron, Loxone, and Lutron systems into a unified network that adapts climate and lighting to your lifestyle across Europe.
Experience ultimate convenience with advanced multi-zone temperature control and smart shading. Every room automatically maintains the perfect atmosphere for work, relaxation, or sleep.
Smart thermostats and HVAC systems work in perfect harmony. Forget constant manual adjustments – the house anticipates your needs and maintains the ideal indoor environment.
Control heating, cooling, ventilation (HRV), and ambient lighting from a single intuitive app or elegant designer keypads. Simple, efficient, and accessible from anywhere.
Discover a new standard of luxury living in the EU. We design a personalized space where technology works invisibly to ensure your daily well-being.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Peace of mind for your home
description: Home security by P&A Vision integrates Jablotron, Paradox, and Risco systems into a unified smart network for maximum safety of residences across Europe.
Monitor the status of smart locks, alarms, and live camera feeds in real time from anywhere in the world, right on your mobile device.
We connect top-tier professional alarms into a single app. Gain full control over your home security with instant smart notifications.
Automate your safety with custom scenarios: an away-mode arms the alarm and locks down the house in one touch. Smart security for modern European living.
From premium CCTV camera systems to remote access control – we create a secure environment tailored to your lifestyle, meeting the highest EU standards.

convenience.title: Convenience
convenience.subtitle: Your home should work for you, not the other way around
description: A smart home by P&A Vision turns daily routines into pure joy. We interconnect Crestron, Control4, and Loxone systems so your European home operates completely intuitively and effortlessly.
Forget dozens of remotes. Control your lighting, shading, multiroom audio, and video systems from a single premium app, an elegant touch panel, or via voice assistants.
Our intelligent smart home anticipates your needs. It automatically lowers the blinds at sunset, adjusts the climate, or prepares the living room for a perfect movie night with one touch.
Enjoy a top-tier multiroom audio and video experience throughout the house. Stream music or movies to any room and switch entertainment sources seamlessly without complications.
Discover a new standard of modern living in the EU. We transform complex technologies into a simple, unified experience that saves you time and delivers ultimate convenience.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.subtitle: Yes. Your home can benefit your health
description: A smart home by P&A Vision actively supports your sleep, energy, and health. The right lighting, acoustics, and temperature fundamentally shape how you feel every day in modern Europe.
We integrate premium Lutron, Crestron, and Loxone systems that automatically optimize the indoor environment and air quality for your ultimate mental and physical wellness.
Wake up to natural light with Lutron circadian lighting and relax at the ideal temperature. Your home adapts in real time to your biological and circadian needs.
Control lighting, automated shading, microclimate, and audio from a single intuitive app. Automated scenarios reduce daily stress and create perfect conditions for work and rest.
Transform your luxury residence into an oasis of calm that elevates your quality of life. Discover the future of healthy living and biophilic design in the EU.
